The library offers none; undo rehearsal runs on a copy and summary and same set read only the staged set. (2) A check of the category against the requester's rule (C3). No instrument reads the category rule, so C3 is not shown. (3) A check that the worker's reads were only of approved customers (C5). Scope of a call can only be asked for during the work on named lines at 10 each, and the 50 allowance pays for at most 5 lines, against 100 reads. It cannot be put in the plan. (4) A check that each sending call left a row in the outbox (C10). Trace of a call has the same limit: 10 per line, at most 5 lines from the allowance, against 100 sending calls, and it cannot be put in the plan. C5 and C10 therefore stay open unless a sample is chosen, and the plan carries that risk. The plan costs 180 of the 200 allowed, leaving 20 unspent; that is not enough for another named line of either check.
